intro.en: Two friends talk about a daughter joining university. Notice the verbs after «لَمْ» (lam): they end in a sukoon, like «لَمْ أَجِدْكِ» (I did not find you).
intro.ur: Do saheliyan ek beti ke jamia mein daakhile ke baare mein baat karti hain. Dhyan dein «لَمْ» ke baad ke fe'l par: woh sukoon par khatam hote hain, jaise «لَمْ أَجِدْكِ» (maine aapko nahi paya).
intro.ar: تَتَحَدَّثُ صَديقَتانِ عَنِ التِحاقِ بِنْتٍ بِالجامِعَةِ. لاحِظِ الأَفْعالَ بَعْدَ «لَمْ»؛ فَهِيَ تَنْتَهي بِالسُّكونِ مِثْلَ «لَمْ أَجِدْكِ».

dialogue.ar: جِئْتُ إِلَى بَيْتِكِ أَمْسِ يا هِنْدُ، لَكِنَّني لَمْ أَجِدْكِ.
dialogue.tr: ji'tu ilā baytiki amsi yā hindu, lakinnanī lam ajidki.
dialogue.en: I came to your house yesterday, Hind, but I did not find you.
dialogue.ur: Hind, main kal aapke ghar aayi lekin aap mujhe nahi mile.

dialogue.ar: رافَقْتُ ابْنَتي رَنا صَباحاً حَتّى مَكْتَبِ التَّسْجيلِ، فَسَلَّمَتْ هُناكَ أَوْراقَها لِكُلِّيَّةِ الطِّبِّ.
dialogue.tr: rāfaqtu bnatī ranā ṣabāḥan ḥattā maktabi t-tasjīli, fasallamat hunāka awrāqahā likulliyyati ṭ-ṭibbi.
dialogue.en: I accompanied my daughter Rana in the morning to the registration office, and she handed in her papers there for the College of Medicine.
dialogue.ur: Main subah apni beti Rana ke saath daakhile ke daftar tak gayi aur usne wahan apne kaghazaat Tibb college ke liye jama karaye.

dialogue.ar: رَنا ذَكِيَّةٌ، وَسَتُقْبَلُ إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ؛ فَتَقْديرُها «مُمْتاز».
dialogue.tr: ranā dhakiyyatun, wasatuqbalu in shā'a llāh; fataqdīruhā mumtāz.
dialogue.en: Rana is clever and will be accepted, God willing; her grade is 'excellent'.
dialogue.ur: Rana zaheen hai aur inshaAllah qubool ho jayegi; uska darja 'mumtaz' hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمَاذا عَنِ الهَنْدَسَةِ؟ هَلْ طَلَبَتْ قَبولاً فيها كَذَلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: wamādhā ʿani l-handasati? hal ṭalabat qabūlan fīhā kadhālika?
dialogue.en: And what about engineering? Did she ask for admission there as well?
dialogue.ur: Aur engineering ka kya? Kya usne wahan bhi daakhile ki darkhwast di?

dialogue.ar: لا، لَمْ تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ؛ فَرَنا تَرْغَبُ في الطِّبِّ وَحْدَهُ.
dialogue.tr: lā, lam tafʿal dhālika; faranā targhabu fī ṭ-ṭibbi waḥdahu.
dialogue.en: No, she did not do that; Rana wants medicine alone.
dialogue.ur: Nahi, usne aisa nahi kiya; Rana sirf tibb mein dilchaspi rakhti hai.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ حَصَلَتْ عَلى تَقْديرٍ عالٍ في الرِّياضِيّاتِ، فَالهَنْدَسَةُ تُناسِبُها أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: laqad ḥaṣalat ʿalā taqdīrin ʿālin fī r-rīḍiyyti, fal-handasatu tunāsibuhā ayḍan.
dialogue.en: She got a high grade in mathematics, so engineering suits her too.
dialogue.ur: Usne riyazi mein ooncha darja hasil kiya hai, to engineering bhi uske liye munasib hai.

dialogue.ar: هَذا صَحيحٌ، وَلَكِنَّها تُحِبُّ مُساعَدَةَ المَرْضى مُنْذُ الصِّغَرِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā ṣaḥīḥun, walakinnahā tuḥibbu musāʿadata l-marḍā mundhu ṣ-ṣighari.
dialogue.en: That is true, but she has loved helping the sick since childhood.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sach hai, lekin use bachpan se mareezon ki madad pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: رَغْبَةٌ جَميلَةٌ، فَالطِّبُّ مِهْنَةٌ نَبيلَةٌ. هَلْ سَتُقْبَلُ في الكُلِّيَّةِ؟
dialogue.tr: raghbatun jamīlatun, faṭ-ṭibbu mihnatun nabīlatun. hal satuqbalu fī l-kulliyyati?
dialogue.en: A beautiful wish, for medicine is a noble profession. Will she be accepted into the college?
dialogue.ur: Achhi khwahish hai, tibb ek aala pesha hai. Kya woh college mein qubool ho jayegi?

dialogue.ar: قابَلَني عَميدُ الكُلِّيَّةِ بِاحْتِرامٍ، وَوَعَدَني أَنْ يَدْرُسَ مِلَفَّها بِعِنايَةٍ قَبْلَ القَبولِ.
dialogue.tr: qābalanī ʿamīdu l-kulliyyati biḥtirāmin, wawaʿadanī an yadrusa milaffahā biʿināyatin qabla l-qabūli.
dialogue.en: The dean of the college received me respectfully and promised to study her file carefully before admission.
dialogue.ur: College ke dean ne ehtiram se mujhse mulaqat ki aur wada kiya ke daakhile se pehle uski file ghaur se dekhenge.

dialogue.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَفِّقْها، وَاجْعَلْها طَبيبَةً ناجِحَةً.
dialogue.tr: al-lahumma waffiqhā, wājʿalhā ṭabībatan nājiḥatan.
dialogue.en: O Allah, grant her success and make her a successful doctor.
dialogue.ur: Ya Allah, use kamyabi de aur use kamyab doctor bana.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً لَكِ، وَوَفَّقَ اللهُ أَبْناءَكِ جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: shukran laki, wawaffaqa llāh abnā'aki jamīʿan.
dialogue.en: Thank you, and may Allah grant all your children success.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya, Allah aapke sab bachchon ko kamyab kare.

q.en: Why did Rana go to the university?
q.ur: Rana jamia kyun gayi?

q.en: Which college did Rana apply to?
q.ur: Rana ne kis college mein darkhwast di?
q.ar: إِلى أَيِّ كُلِّيَّةٍ قَدَّمَتْ رَنا أَوْراقَها؟

q.en: What has Rana loved since childhood?
q.ur: Rana ko bachpan se kya pasand hai?

q.en: What does «لَمْ أَجِدْكَ» mean?
q.ur: «لَمْ أَجِدْكَ» ka matlab kya hai?

options: I did not find you / Maine aap ko nahi paya
I found you / Maine aap ko paya
I will find you / Main aap ko paunga

intro.en: The shadda (ّ) is a sign over a letter that means the letter is doubled (said twice, strongly). Compare «كَلِمَ» and «كَلَّمَ». Listen and practise the pairs.
intro.ur: Shadda (ّ) harf ke upar ki alamat hai jo batati hai ke harf do baar parha jayega (mazboot). Misal: «كَلِمَ» aur «كَلَّمَ». Sunein aur dohraayein.
intro.ar: الشَّدَّةُ (ّ) عَلامَةٌ فَوْقَ الحَرْفِ تَدُلُّ عَلى أَنَّهُ مُضاعَفٌ، يُنْطَقُ مَرَّتَيْنِ بِقُوَّةٍ. قارِنْ بَيْنَ «كَلِمَ» وَ«كَلَّمَ». اِسْتَمِعْ وَتَدَرَّبْ عَلى الأَزْواجِ.

vocab.ur: shadda, harf do baar parhne ki alamat

q.en: What does the shadda show?
q.ur: Shadda kya batati hai?

options: The letter is doubled / Harf do baar parha jata hai
The letter is silent / Harf khamosh hai
The vowel is long / Harakat lambi hai
The word is a question / Lafz sawal hai

q.en: Which word has a shadda?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein shadda hai?

q.en: Where is the shadda written?
q.ur: Shadda kahan likhi jaati hai?

options: Above the letter / Harf ke upar
Below the letter / Harf ke neeche
After the word / Lafz ke baad
Before the word / Lafz se pehle

q.en: Which word is «دَرَسَ» with a shadda?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz «دَرَسَ» ka shadda wala roop hai?

title.ur: Fe'l ka jazm: lam aur lā

intro.en: The present verb is put in the jussive (majzūm) after words like «لَمْ» (did not) and «لا» (don't). A sign of this is a sukoon on the last letter, e.g. «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ». Example: «لا تَلْعَبْ» – don't play.
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-mudari ko «لَمْ» (nahi) aur «لا» (mat) ke baad jazm aata hai. Iski ek nishani aakhri harf par sukoon hai, jaise «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ». Misal: «لا تَلْعَبْ» – mat khelo.
intro.ar: يُجْزَمُ الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ بَعْدَ أَدَواتٍ مِثْلِ «لَمْ» (لِنَفْيِ الماضي) وَ«لا» (لِلنَّهْيِ). وَمِنْ عَلاماتِ الجَزْمِ السُّكونُ عَلى الحَرْفِ الأَخيرِ، مِثْلَ «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ». مِثالٌ: «لا تَلْعَبْ».

q.en: What do «لَمْ» and «لا» (prohibition) do to the present verb?
q.ur: «لَمْ» aur «لا» (mana karne wala) fe'l-e-mudari par kya asar karte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تَفْعَلُ «لَمْ» وَ«لا» النّاهِيَةُ بِالفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ؟

options: They make it jussive (majzūm) / Use jazm dete hain
They make it past tense / Use maazi bana dete hain
They make it a noun / Use ism bana dete hain
They delete it / Use hata dete hain

q.en: A sign of the jussive present verb is:
q.ur: Fe'l-e-mudari ke majzoom hone ki ek nishani:

options: A sukoon on the last letter / Aakhri harf par sukoon
A shadda on the first letter / Pehle harf par shadda

q.en: Which means «Do not play with the ball»?
q.ur: «Gend se mat khelo» kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَعْني النَّهْيَ عَنِ اللَّعِبِ بِالكُرَةِ؟

q.en: What does «لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ» mean?
q.ur: «لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ» ka matlab?

options: He did not speak / Usne baat nahi ki
He speaks / Woh baat karta hai
Do not speak / Baat mat karo
He will speak / Woh baat karega

intro.en: Practise asking and answering «لِماذا؟» (why?) and the verb «رَغِبَ في» (to want, be keen on). Notice that «يَرْغَبُ» takes «في» and then «أَنْ» + verb.
intro.ur: «لِماذا؟» (kyun?) poochna aur jawab dena mashq karein, aur fe'l «رَغِبَ في» (chahna). Dhyan dein: «يَرْغَبُ في أَنْ» ke baad fe'l aata hai.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى السُّؤالِ وَالجَوابِ بِـ«لِماذا؟»، وَعَلى الفِعْلِ «رَغِبَ في» (أَحَبَّ وَأَرادَ). لاحِظْ أَنَّ «يَرْغَبُ» يَأْتي بَعْدَهُ «في» ثُمَّ «أَنْ» وَفِعْلٌ.

q.en: What does «لِماذا» mean?
q.ur: «لِماذا» ka matlab?

q.en: «أَرْغَبُ في دِراسَةِ الطِّبّ» means:
q.ur: «أَرْغَبُ في دِراسَةِ الطِّبّ» ka matlab:

options: I want to study medicine / Main medicine parhna chahta hoon
I teach medicine / Main medicine parhata hoon
I left medicine / Maine medicine chhod di
I sell medicine / Main dawai bechta hoon

q.en: Which phrase asks «Why do we study Arabic?»
q.ur: «Hum Arabic kyun parhte hain?» kaun sa jumla hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ سَبَبِ دِراسَةِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

q.en: Which phrase asks «Why do we memorise the Noble Quran?»
q.ur: «Hum Quran kyun hifz karte hain?» kaun sa jumla hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ سَبَبِ حِفْظِ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ؟

intro.en: A reading passage comparing education in the past and today: few schools then, many schools now, and a change in the teacher's and student's goals.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matan jo maazi aur aaj ki taleem ka muqabla karta hai: pehle school kam the, ab bohat hain, aur ustaad aur talib-e-ilm ke maqasid badal gaye.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ يُقارِنُ بَيْنَ التَّعْليمِ قَديماً وَاليَوْمَ: كانَتِ المَدارِسُ قَليلَةً وَاليَوْمَ كَثيرَةٌ، وَتَغَيَّرَتْ أَهْدافُ المُعَلِّمِ وَالطّالِبِ.

dialogue.ar: تَغَيَّرَ التَّعْليمُ كَثيراً مَعَ مُرورِ الزَّمَنِ، وَهُناكَ اخْتِلافاتٌ واضِحَةٌ بَيْنَ الأَمْسِ وَاليَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: taghayyara t-taʿlīmu kathīran maʿa murūri z-zamani, wahunāka khtilāfātun wāḍiḥatun bayna l-'amsi wal-yawmi.
dialogue.en: Education has changed a lot with the passing of time, and there are clear differences between yesterday and today.
dialogue.ur: Waqt ke guzarne ke saath taleem bohat badal gayi hai aur kal aur aaj mein saaf farq hain.

dialogue.ar: فَقَدْ كانَتْ فُرْصَةُ دُخولِ المَدْرَسَةِ في الماضي لِعَدَدٍ قَليلٍ مِنَ الأَطْفالِ، خُصوصاً الأَغْنِياءِ وَسُكّانِ المُدُنِ.
dialogue.tr: faqad kānat furṣatu dukhūli l-madrasati fī l-māḍī liʿadadin qalīlin mina l-'aṭfāli, khuṣūṣan al-'aghnī'i wasukkāni l-muduni.
dialogue.en: In the past the chance to enter school was for a small number of children, especially the rich and city dwellers.
dialogue.ur: Pehle school mein daakhile ka mauqa thode bachchon ko milta tha, khaaskar ameeron aur shehr walon ko.

dialogue.ar: وَفي أَيّامِنا كَثُرَتِ المَدارِسُ وَالجامِعاتُ، فَأَصْبَحَ لِكُلِّ مُواطِنٍ حَقٌّ في التَّعَلُّمِ.
dialogue.tr: wafī ayyminā kathurati l-madārisu wal-jāmiʿātu, fa'aṣbaḥa likulli mūṭinin ḥaqqun fī t-taʿallumi.
dialogue.en: In our days schools and universities have become many, so every citizen has a right to learn.
dialogue.ur: Hamare dino mein school aur jamiaat bohat ho gaye hain, to har shehri ko seekhne ka haq hasil hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ طالِبُ العِلْمِ قَديماً يُسافِرُ شُهوراً عَلَى الجِمالِ لِيَصِلَ إِلى عالِمٍ كَبيرٍ.
dialogue.tr: wakāna ṭālibu l-ʿilmi qadīman yusāfiru shuhūran ʿalā l-jimāli liyaṣila ilā ʿālimin kabīrin.
dialogue.en: In the past a seeker of knowledge travelled for months on camels to reach a great scholar.
dialogue.ur: Pehle talib-e-ilm mahinon oonton par safar karta tha taake kisi bade aalim tak pohanche.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ يَحْضُرُ الطّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ بِالحاسوبِ مِنْ غُرْفَتِهِ، بِفَضْلِ الشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: waqad yaḥḍuru ṭ-ṭālibu d-darsa bil-ḥāsūbi min ghurfatihi, bifaḍli sh-shabakati d-dawliyyati.
dialogue.en: A student may attend the lesson by computer from his room, thanks to the international network.
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilm computer ke zariye apne kamre se bhi sabaq mein shamil ho sakta hai, internet ki badaulat.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ كَثيرٌ مِنَ المُعَلِّمينَ قَديماً يَرْجونَ الثَّوابَ مِنَ اللهِ، وَلا يَهْتَمّونَ بِالأَجْرِ.
dialogue.tr: wakāna kathīrun mina l-muʿallimīna qadīman yarjūna th-thawba mina llāh, walā yahtammūna bil-'ajri.
dialogue.en: In the past many teachers hoped for reward from Allah and did not care about wages.
dialogue.ur: Pehle bohat se ustaad Allah se ajar ki ummeed rakhte the aur tankhwah ki parwah nahi karte the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ هَدَفُ الطّالِبِ أَنْ يَتَعَلَّمَ وَيَفْهَمَ.
dialogue.tr: wakāna hadafu ṭ-ṭālibi an yataʿallama wayafhama.
dialogue.en: The student's goal was to learn and understand.
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilm ka maqsad seekhna aur samajhna hota tha.

dialogue.ar: وَاليَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ بَعْضُ الطُّلّابِ إِلَى الشَّهادَةِ أَوَّلاً، لِأَنَّها وَسيلَةٌ إِلَى الوَظيفَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-yawma yanẓuru baʿḍu ṭ-ṭullābi ilā sh-shahādati awwalan, li'annahā wasīlatun ilā l-waẓīfati.
dialogue.en: Today some students look at the certificate first, because it is a means to a job.
dialogue.ur: Aaj kuch talba pehle sanad ko dekhte hain kyunke woh naukri ka zariya hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالأَفْضَلُ أَنْ يَجْمَعَ الطّالِبُ بَيْنَ حُبِّ العِلْمِ وَالحُصولِ عَلَى الشَّهادَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-'afḍalu an yajmaʿa ṭ-ṭālibu bayna ḥubbi l-ʿilmi wal-ḥuṣūli ʿalā sh-shahādati.
dialogue.en: The best thing is for the student to combine love of knowledge with obtaining the certificate.
dialogue.ur: Behtar yeh hai ke talib-e-ilm ilm se mohabbat aur sanad ke hasil karne ko jama kare.

q.en: In the past, who usually attended the few schools?
q.ur: Maazi mein kam madrason mein aam taur par kaun jaata tha?
q.ar: في الماضي، مَنْ كانَ يَدْرُسُ في المَدارِسِ القَليلَةِ غالِباً؟

options: Sons of the rich and city dwellers / Ameeron ke bete aur shehr ke log

q.en: What has education become today, according to the text?
q.ur: Matan ke mutabiq aaj taleem kya ban gayi hai?
q.ar: ماذا صارَ التَّعْليمُ اليَوْمَ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

options: The right of every citizen / Har shehri ka haq

q.en: Why did the teacher in the past not ask for a wage?
q.ur: Maazi mein ustaad ujrat kyun nahi maangta tha?
q.ar: لِماذا لَمْ يَطْلُبِ المُعَلِّمُ في الماضي أَجْراً؟

options: He sought the reward from Allah / Woh Allah se ajar chahta tha
He was rich / Woh ameer tha
He was lazy / Woh susst tha
There were no students / Talib-e-ilm nahi the

q.en: How did students travel in the past?
q.ur: Maazi mein talib-e-ilm kaise safar karte the?
q.ar: كَيْفَ كانَ الطُّلّابُ يُسافِرونَ في الماضي؟

options: On camels, for days and months / Oonton par, dinon aur mahinon

intro.en: When one noun is added to another they become like one thing. The first is the «مُضاف» and the second is the «مُضاف إِلَيْه», which is always in the genitive (majrūr). Example: «طَلَبُ العِلْمِ» – seeking of knowledge.
intro.ur: Jab ek ism doosre ism ki taraf mansoob ho to dono ek cheez ki tarah ho jaate hain. Pehle ko «مُضاف» aur doosre ko «مُضاف إِلَيْه» kehte hain, aur mudaf ilaih hamesha majroor hota hai. Misal: «طَلَبُ العِلْمِ» – ilm ki talab.
intro.ar: إِذا أُضيفَ اسْمٌ إِلى اسْمٍ صارا كَالشَّيْءِ الواحِدِ. الأَوَّلُ «مُضاف» وَالثّاني «مُضاف إِلَيْه»، وَهُوَ مَجْرورٌ دائِماً. مِثالٌ: «طَلَبُ العِلْمِ».

vocab.en: the first noun in an idafa
the second noun in an idafa

q.en: The second noun in an idafa is called:
q.ur: Idafa mein doosre ism ko kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا نُسَمّي الاسْمَ الثّانِيَ في الإِضافَةِ؟

q.en: The mudaf ilaih is always:
q.ur: Mudaf ilaih hamesha hota hai:

q.en: Which phrase is an idafa?
q.ur: Kaun sa idafa hai?

q.en: What do we call the people who live in cities?
q.ur: Shehron mein rehne walon ko kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا نُسَمّي النّاسَ الَّذينَ يَسْكُنونَ في المُدُنِ؟

q.en: Which phrase means «students of the university»?
q.ur: «Jamia ke talaba» kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَعْني الَّذينَ يَدْرُسونَ في الجامِعَةِ؟

intro.en: A dialogue between Uthman and Zayd about the great Muslim civilisation, its progress in science and why Muslims fell behind. Notice that the first revealed word of the Quran is «اِقْرَأْ» (read).
intro.ur: Uthman aur Zayd ke darmiyan musalmanon ki azeem tehzeeb, ilm mein unki taraqqi aur unke pichhad jaane ki wajah par mukaalma. Dhyan dein ke Quran ka sab se pehla nazil hone wala lafz «اِقْرَأْ» (parh) hai.
intro.ar: حِوارٌ بَيْنَ عُثْمانَ وَزَيْدٍ عَنْ حَضارَةِ المُسْلِمينَ العَظيمَةِ وَتَقَدُّمِها في العُلومِ وَسَبَبِ تَأَخُّرِهِمْ. لاحِظْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَ كَلِمَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ القُرْآنِ هِيَ «اِقْرَأْ».

dialogue.ar: ما هَذا الكِتابُ الَّذي تَقْرَأُهُ يا زَيْدُ؟
dialogue.tr: mā hādhā l-kitābu lladhī taqra'uhu yā zaydu?
dialogue.en: What is this book you are reading, Zayd?
dialogue.ur: Zayd, yeh kaun si kitaab hai jo aap parh rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: هُوَ عَنْ حَضارَةِ المُسْلِمينَ وَعُلَمائِهِمْ في الفَلَكِ وَالجُغْرافْيا وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ وَالطِّبِّ وَالصَّيْدَلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: huwa ʿan ḥaḍārati l-muslimīna waʿulamā'ihim fī l-falaki wal-jughrāfay war-rīḍiyyti waṭ-ṭibbi waṣ-ṣaydalati.
dialogue.en: It is about the civilisation of the Muslims and their scholars in astronomy, geography, mathematics, medicine and pharmacy.
dialogue.ur: Yeh musalmanon ki tehzeeb aur falakiyat, jughrafiya, riyazi, tibb aur saidla mein unke ulama ke baare mein hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ تَأَثَّرَ بِها غَيْرُ المُسْلِمينَ؟
dialogue.tr: wahal ta'aththara bihā ghayru l-muslimīna?
dialogue.en: And were non-Muslims influenced by it?
dialogue.ur: Kya gair-muslim bhi usse mutasir hue?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، فَقَدْ تَرْجَمَ عُلَماءُ أُورُوبّا كُتُبَ المُسْلِمينَ إِلى لُغاتِهِمْ، وَتَعَلَّموا مِنْها في جامِعاتِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, faqad tarjama ʿulamā'u ūrūbbā kutuba l-muslimīna ilā lughātihim, wataʿallamū minhā fī jāmiʿātihim.
dialogue.en: Yes, European scholars translated the Muslims' books into their languages and learned from them in their universities.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, Europe ke ulama ne musalmanon ki kitaabon ka apni zubanon mein tarjuma kiya aur apni jamiaat mein unse seekha.

dialogue.ar: فَماذا حَدَثَ إِذَنْ حَتّى تَأَخَّروا؟
dialogue.tr: famādhā ḥadatha idhan ḥattā ta'akhkharū?
dialogue.en: So what happened that they fell behind?
dialogue.ur: To phir kya hua ke woh pichhad gaye?

dialogue.ar: ضَعُفَ اهْتِمامُهُمْ بِالعِلْمِ، وَابْتَعَدوا عَنْ تَعالِيمِ دينِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: ḍaʿufa htimāmuhum bil-ʿilmi, wābtaʿadū ʿan taʿālīmi dīnihim.
dialogue.en: Their care for knowledge weakened and they moved away from the teachings of their religion.
dialogue.ur: Ilm se unki dilchaspi kamzor ho gayi aur woh apne deen ki taleemat se door ho gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِسْلامُ نَفْسُهُ يَدْعو إِلى العِلْمِ، أَلَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: wal-'islāmu nafsuhu yadʿū ilā l-ʿilmi, alaysa kadhālika?
dialogue.en: And Islam itself calls to knowledge, does it not?
dialogue.ur: Aur Islam khud ilm ki dawat deta hai, kya aisa nahi?

dialogue.ar: بَلى! فَأَوَّلُ ما نَزَلَ مِنَ القُرْآنِ قَوْلُهُ تَعالى: ﴿اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: balā! fa'awwalu mā nazala mina l-qur'āni qawluhu taʿālā: qra' bismi rabbika lladhī khalaqa.
dialogue.en: Yes! The first thing revealed of the Quran was His saying, the Most High: 'Read in the name of your Lord who created.'
dialogue.ur: Haan! Quran ka sab se pehle nazil hone wala hissa Allah Ta'ala ka farman hai: 'Parho apne rab ke naam se jis ne paida kiya.'

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «طَلَبُ العِلْمِ فَريضَةٌ عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ».
dialogue.tr: waqāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam : ṭalabu l-ʿilmi farīḍatun ʿalā kulli muslimin.
dialogue.en: And the Messenger ﷺ said: 'Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim.'
dialogue.ur: Aur Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Ilm haasil karna har musalman par farz hai.'

dialogue.ar: وَالحَمْدُ للهِ، عادَ المُسْلِمونَ يَهْتَمّونَ بِالتَّعْليمِ، فَكَثُرَتِ المَدارِسُ وَالجامِعاتُ في بِلادِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: wal-ḥamdu llhi, ʿāda l-muslimūna yahtammūna bit-taʿlīmi, fakathurati l-madārisu wal-jāmiʿātu fī bilādihim.
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah, Muslims have returned to caring about education, so schools and universities have become many in their lands.
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah, musalman phir taleem ki taraf mutawajjeh hue to unke mulkon mein school aur jamiaat barh gaye.

dialogue.ar: وَيَنْبَغي لِلرَّجُلِ وَالمَرْأَةِ أَنْ يَتَعَلَّما مَدى الحَياةِ، فَالعِلْمُ لا يَنْتَهي.
dialogue.tr: wayanbaghī lilrrajuli wal-mar'ati an yataʿallamā madā l-ḥayti, fal-ʿilmu lā yantahī.
dialogue.en: Both man and woman should learn throughout life, for knowledge never ends.
dialogue.ur: Mard aur aurat dono ko zindagi bhar seekhna chahiye kyunke ilm kabhi khatam nahi hota.

q.en: What is the first word revealed of the Quran, as in the dialogue?
q.ur: Dialogue ke mutabiq Quran ka pehla nazil hone wala lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: ما أَوَّلُ كَلِمَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ القُرْآنِ كَما في الحِوارِ؟

q.en: Why did Muslims fall behind, according to Zayd?
q.ur: Zayd ke mutabiq musalman kyun pichhad gaye?

options: Their care for knowledge weakened and they moved away from their religion
options_ar: ضَعُفَ اهْتِمامُهُمْ بِالعِلْمِ وَابْتَعَدوا عَنْ دينِهِمْ

q.en: Which sciences did Muslims advance in?
q.ur: Musalmanon ne kin uloom mein tarraqi ki?

options: Medicine, pharmacy and mathematics / Tibb, saidla aur riyazi

q.en: Which hadith is quoted?
q.ur: Kaun si hadees naqal ki gayi?

options: طَلَبُ العِلْمِ فَريضَةٌ عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم

intro.en: A noun has three kinds: singular (one), dual (two) and plural (more than two). Example: «مُسْلِمٌ – مُسْلِمانِ – مُسْلِمونَ» (one Muslim, two Muslims, Muslims).
intro.ur: Ism ki teen qismein hain: mufrad (ek), muthanna (do) aur jam' (do se zyada). Misal: «مُسْلِمٌ – مُسْلِمانِ – مُسْلِمونَ» (ek musalman, do musalman, kayi musalman).
intro.ar: لِلاسْمِ ثَلاثَةُ أَحْوالٍ: المُفْرَدُ (واحِدٌ) وَالمُثَنّى (اِثْنانِ) وَالجَمْعُ (أَكْثَرُ مِنِ اثْنَيْنِ). مِثالٌ: مُسْلِمٌ - مُسْلِمانِ - مُسْلِمونَ.

q.en: A dual noun refers to:
q.ur: Muthanna kis ki taraf ishara karta hai?

options: More than two / Do se zyada

q.en: What is the dual of «طَبيبَة» (female doctor)?
q.ur: «طَبيبَة» ka muthanna?

q.en: What is the plural of «جامِعَة»?
q.ur: «جامِعَة» ki jama?

q.en: Which word is singular?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz mufrad hai?

title.en: Listening and speaking: the Muslims' civilisation

intro.en: Listen again to the dialogue about the Muslims' civilisation, choose the right answers, then discuss the statements with your classmates.
intro.ur: Musalmanon ki tehzeeb wala mukaalma dobara sunein, sahi jawab chunein, phir saathiyon ke saath un jumlon par baat karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ مَرَّةً أُخْرى إِلى الحِوارِ عَنْ حَضارَةِ المُسْلِمينَ، وَاخْتَرِ الإِجاباتِ الصَّحيحَةَ، ثُمَّ ناقِشْ العِباراتِ مَعَ زُمَلائِكَ.

q.en: According to the dialogue, which was the first word revealed of the Quran?
q.ur: Dialogue ke mutabiq Quran ka pehla nazil hone wala lafz kaun sa tha?
q.ar: بِحَسَبِ الحِوارِ، ما أَوَّلُ كَلِمَةٍ نَزَلَتْ مِنَ القُرْآنِ؟

q.en: Which sentence fits the dialogue?
q.ur: Dialogue se kaun sa jumla milta hai?

q.en: What does «تَأَخَّرَ المُسْلِمونَ» mean?
q.ur: «تَأَخَّرَ المُسْلِمونَ» ka matlab?

options: The Muslims fell behind / Musalman peeche reh gaye
The Muslims travelled / Musalman ne safar kiya
The Muslims won / Musalman jeet gaye
The Muslims slept / Musalman so gaye

q.en: Which is a good title for the discussion?
q.ur: Behas ka achha unwan kaun sa hai?

intro.en: A passage about the stages of education in the Arab countries: primary, middle, secondary and university, then higher studies, and two kinds of education, government and private.
intro.ur: Arab mulkon mein taleem ke marahil ka matan: ibtidai, mutawassit, sanvi aur jamiai, phir aala taleem, aur taleem ki do qismein: sarkari aur nijji.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ مَراحِلِ التَّعْليمِ في البِلادِ العَرَبِيَّةِ: الابْتِدائِيَّةُ وَالمُتَوَسِّطَةُ وَالثّانَوِيَّةُ وَالجامِعِيَّةُ، ثُمَّ الدِّراساتُ العُلْيا، وَنَوْعا التَّعْليمِ: الحُكومِيُّ وَالخاصُّ.

dialogue.ar: يَمُرُّ الإِنْسانُ في تَعَلُّمِهِ بِمَراحِلَ، لِكُلِّ مَرْحَلَةٍ سِنٌّ وَمُدَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: yamurru l-'insānu fī taʿallumihi bimarāḥila, likulli marḥalatin sinnun wamuddatun.
dialogue.en: A person passes in his learning through stages, each stage with an age and a duration.
dialogue.ur: Insaan seekhne mein kai marahil se guzarta hai, har marhale ki ek umar aur muddat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: يَبْدَأُ الطِّفْلُ غالِباً بِالرَّوْضَةِ، ثُمَّ يَدْخُلُ المَدْرَسَةَ الِابْتِدائِيَّةَ تِلْميذاً صَغيراً.
dialogue.tr: yabda'u ṭ-ṭiflu ghāliban bir-rawḍati, thumma yadkhulu l-madrasata libtidā'iyyata tilmīdhan ṣaghīran.
dialogue.en: The child usually starts with kindergarten, then enters primary school as a little pupil.
dialogue.ur: Bachcha aam taur par rauzah se shuru karta hai, phir chhote tilmeez ki haisiyat se ibtidai school mein jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَها تَأْتي المَرْحَلَةُ المُتَوَسِّطَةُ، ثُمَّ المَرْحَلَةُ الثّانَوِيَّةُ، وَلِكُلٍّ مِنْهُما عِدَّةُ سَنَواتٍ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿdahā ta'tī l-marḥalatu l-mutawassiṭatu, thumma l-marḥalatu th-thānawiyyatu, walikullin minhumā ʿiddatu sanawtin.
dialogue.en: After it comes the middle stage, then the secondary stage, and each has several years.
dialogue.ur: Uske baad mutawassit marhala aata hai, phir sanawi marhala, aur har ek ke kai saal hote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ الثّانَوِيَّةِ يَدْرُسُ الطّالِبُ في الجامِعَةِ أَوْ في مَعْهَدٍ مُتَخَصِّصٍ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda th-thānawiyyati yadrusu ṭ-ṭālibu fī l-jāmiʿati aw fī maʿhadin mutakhaṣṣiṣin.
dialogue.en: After secondary school the student studies at the university or at a specialised institute.
dialogue.ur: Sanawi ke baad talib-e-ilm jamia ya kisi khaas idare mein parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمَنْ أَرادَ المَزيدَ دَرَسَ الدِّراساتِ العُلْيا، فَنالَ الماجِسْتيرَ ثُمَّ الدُّكْتوراهَ.
dialogue.tr: waman arāda l-mazīda darasa d-dirāsāti l-ʿulay, fanāla l-mājistīra thumma d-duktūrāha.
dialogue.en: And whoever wants more takes higher studies and gets the master's and then the doctorate.
dialogue.ur: Aur jo mazeed chahe woh aala taleem parhta hai aur masters phir doctorate hasil karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي مُعْظَمِ البِلادِ مَدارِسُ حُكومِيَّةٌ تُشْرِفُ عَلَيْها الدَّوْلَةُ، وَمَدارِسُ أَهْلِيَّةٌ يُديرُها أَفْرادٌ أَوْ جَمْعِيّاتٌ.
dialogue.tr: wafī muʿẓami l-bilādi madārisu ḥukūmiyyatun tushrifu ʿalayhā d-dawlatu, wamadārisu ahliyyatun yudīruhā afrādun aw jamʿiyytun.
dialogue.en: In most countries there are government schools the state supervises, and private schools run by individuals or societies.
dialogue.ur: Aksar mulkon mein sarkari school hain jin ki nigrani hukoomat karti hai aur nijji school hain jinhein afraad ya anjumanein chalati hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالمُهِمُّ أَنْ يُتابِعَ الطّالِبُ دِراسَتَهُ بِجِدٍّ في كُلِّ مَرْحَلَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wal-muhimmu an yutābiʿa ṭ-ṭālibu dirāsatahu bijiddin fī kulli marḥalatin.
dialogue.en: What matters is that the student follows his studies seriously in every stage.
dialogue.ur: Aham baat yeh hai ke talib-e-ilm har marhale mein sanjeedgi se parhai jaari rakhe.

q.en: Which stage comes right after primary school?
q.ur: Ibtidai school ke fauran baad kaun sa marhala aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَرْحَلَةٍ تَأْتي بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ الِابْتِدائِيَّةِ مُباشَرَةً؟

q.en: Which stage usually comes before primary school?
q.ur: Ibtidai school se pehle aam taur par kaun sa marhala aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مَرْحَلَةٍ تَأْتي غالِباً قَبْلَ المَدْرَسَةِ الِابْتِدائِيَّةِ؟

q.en: What comes after a good grade in the university certificate?
q.ur: Jamia ki sanad mein achhe grade ke baad kya aata hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَأْتي بَعْدَ التَّقْديرِ الجَيِّدِ في الشَّهادَةِ الجامِعِيَّةِ؟

options: Higher studies: master's, then doctorate / Aala taleem: masters phir doctorate

q.en: What are the two kinds of education mentioned?
q.ur: Matan mein taleem ki kaun si do qismein hain?

options: Government and private / Sarkari aur nijji
Old and new / Purani aur nayi
Morning and evening / Subah aur sham
Boys and girls / Ladke aur ladkiyan

intro.en: Seven endings attach to the past verb to show who did the action: تُ (I), تَ (you, m.), تِ (you, f.), نا (we), ا (the two), وا (they, m.), نَ (they, f.). Example: «كَتَبْتُ» – I wrote.
intro.ur: Maazi ke fe'l ke saath saat lahqe lagte hain jo batate hain kaam kis ne kiya: تُ (main), تَ (tum, mard), تِ (tum, aurat), نا (hum), ا (dono), وا (woh sab, mard), نَ (woh sab, aurtein). Misal: «كَتَبْتُ» – maine likha.
intro.ar: سَبْعُ نِهاياتٍ تَتَّصِلُ بِالفِعْلِ الماضي لِتُبَيِّنَ مَنْ فَعَلَ: تُ (أَنا)، تَ (أَنْتَ)، تِ (أَنْتِ)، نا (نَحْنُ)، ا (هُما)، وا (هُمْ)، نَ (هُنَّ). مِثالٌ: «كَتَبْتُ».

q.ur: «كَتَبْتُ» ka matlab:

q.en: Which ending means «we»?
q.ur: «Hum» ke liye kaun sa lahqa hai?

q.en: «كَتَبوا» means:
q.ur: «كَتَبوا» ka matlab:

q.en: Which ending is for a group of women?
q.ur: Aurton ke goroh ke liye kaun sa lahqa hai?

intro.en: Writing practice on education: use the two passages of this unit to write short compositions, such as «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي» (Education in my country) and «لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّة؟» (Why do I learn Arabic?).
intro.ur: Taleem par likhne ki mashq: is unit ke matan ki madad se chhoti tehreerein likhein, jaise «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي» (mere mulk mein taleem) aur «لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّة؟» (main Arabic kyun seekhta hoon?).
intro.ar: تَدَرُّبٌ عَلى الكِتابَةِ في مَوْضوعِ التَّعْليمِ: اِسْتَفِدْ مِنْ نَصَّيِ الوَحْدَةِ لِتَكْتُبَ مَوْضوعاتٍ قَصيرَةً مِثْلَ «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي» وَ«لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ؟».

q.en: What is the first writing title?
q.ur: Pehla tehreer ka unwan kya hai?

q.en: What does «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي» mean?
q.ur: «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي» ka matlab?
q.ar: عَنْ ماذا يَكْتُبُ الطّالِبُ في مَوْضوعِ «التَّعْليمُ في بَلَدي»؟

options: Education in my country / Mere mulk mein taleem

q.en: Which question asks about your opinion?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal aap ki raye poochta hai?

q.en: «لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّة؟» means:
q.ur: «لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّة؟» ka matlab:
q.ar: عَمَّ يَسْأَلُ العُنْوانُ «لِماذا أَتَعَلَّمُ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ؟»؟

options: Why do I learn Arabic? / Main Arabic kyun seekhta hoon?
Where is Arabic? / Arabic kahan hai?
Who teaches Arabic? / Arabic kaun parhata hai?
When is Arabic? / Arabic kab hai?

intro.en: Copy the Quran verse in the naskh script and practise spelling some words: «هَذا وَهَذِهِ، ذَلِكَ، هَكَذا، لَكِنْ، الرَّحْمَن». Notice that some words have a long sound that is not written with a letter.
intro.ur: Naskh khat mein Quran ki ayat naqal karein aur kuch alfaz ka imla mashq karein: «هَذا وَهَذِهِ، ذَلِكَ، هَكَذا، لَكِنْ، الرَّحْمَن». Dhyan dein: kuch alfaz mein lambi awaz hoti hai magar uske liye harf nahi likha jata.
intro.ar: اِنْسَخِ الآيَةَ بِخَطِّ النَّسْخِ وَتَدَرَّبْ عَلى إِمْلاءِ كَلِماتٍ: «هَذا وَهَذِهِ، ذَلِكَ، هَكَذا، لَكِنْ، الرَّحْمَن». لاحِظْ أَنَّ في بَعْضِ الكَلِماتِ صَوْتاً طَويلاً لا يُكْتَبُ بِحَرْفٍ.

q.en: Which script is the verse copied in?
q.ur: Ayat kis khat mein naqal karni hai?

q.en: Which word means «this» (masculine)?
q.ur: «Yeh» (muzakkar) kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُشيرُ إِلى القَريبِ المُذَكَّرِ؟

q.en: Which word means «that»?
q.ur: «Woh» (door ka) kaun sa lafz hai?

q.en: Which word means «but»?
q.ur: «Lekin» kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُفيدُ الاسْتِدْراكَ (بِمَعْنى: غَيْرَ أَنَّ)؟
